AnalysisOut.title: AnalysisOut
AnalysisOut.description: Rule-based, UNCONFIRMED machine output. Every item quotes the source words.

ConsentDecision.title: ConsentDecision
ConsentDecision.description: What the patient agreed to. `version` must match the wording they were shown.

ConsentStatus.title: ConsentStatus
ConsentStatus.description: Latest decision for data-processing consent, and whether it covers current wording.

ContentLanguage.title: ContentLanguage
ContentLanguage.description: Language a patient SPOKE or TYPED in (separate from anyone's UI language).

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Past encounters only. Symptoms, medicines and allergies listed here were reported on the dates shown and must NOT be assumed to be current. 'AI-extracted' items have not been confirmed by staff.

IntakeBrief.title: IntakeBrief
IntakeBrief.description: Staff-confirmed intake information shown to the care team.

IntakePatientView.title: IntakePatientView
IntakePatientView.description: What a patient sees about their own submission.

IntakePriority.title: IntakePriority
IntakePriority.description: Urgent / Normal flag on an intake record (from the existing emergency rules; staff may change it).

IntakeStaffView.title: IntakeStaffView
IntakeStaffView.description: Everything staff need to review an intake. Unreviewed text is labelled by review_status.

MessageExchange.title: MessageExchange
MessageExchange.description: The patient's stored message plus the assistant's acknowledgement.

PatientCreateByStaff.title: PatientCreateByStaff
PatientCreateByStaff.description: Walk-in registration at the front desk (no login account).

PatientEncounterView.title: PatientEncounterView
PatientEncounterView.description: What a patient sees of their own past encounters: staff-confirmed facts only.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Your previous visits. Only information a staff member has confirmed is shown. Past symptoms are not assumed to be current.

PatientSelfRegister.title: PatientSelfRegister
PatientSelfRegister.description: Public sign-up form: creates a patient login AND profile.

PatientUpdate.title: PatientUpdate
PatientUpdate.description: Fields a patient (or staff) may correct. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

PhoneChangeRequest.title: PhoneChangeRequest
PhoneChangeRequest.description: Ask for a code to be sent to a NEW (or not-yet-verified) mobile number.

PriorityChange.title: PriorityChange
PriorityChange.description: A staff member sets the Urgent / Normal flag. The reason is required and kept.

QueueAssign.title: QueueAssign
QueueAssign.description: Omit a field to leave it unchanged; send doctor_user_id: null to unassign.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: How this symptom was found: exact / possible / staff / rejected (no invented percentages).

SymptomOut.title: SymptomOut
SymptomOut.description: A symptom of the CURRENT intake: what the AI found and what staff decided.

SymptomStatus.title: SymptomStatus
SymptomStatus.description: What the patient's words say about one symptom mention (machine-assigned, never edited).

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.description:
Honest warning shown beside the transcript when the speech model does not really
support the spoken language (currently Dogri).

suggested_text.title: Suggested Text
suggested_text.description:
Dogri only: the raw transcript with a few Hindi function words respelled the Dogri way.

A display aid, NOT speech recognition. `text` (the raw transcript) is unchanged and stays the
stored record; this value is never saved by itself: only what the patient approves is.

TranscriptionOut.title: TranscriptionOut
TranscriptionOut.description: Machine transcript for the patient to review before sending.

UiLanguage.title: UiLanguage
UiLanguage.description: Language used to DISPLAY the app to one user (not the spoken-audio language).
